entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.177
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.177 Bots and work See what your bots said to each other. When a bot hands work to a teammate, the hand-off shows as a small chip with the teammate's face and name. Click it to read their conversation right in the chat, live, with "Back" to return to where you were. Handed-off conversations get real names. A conversation a teammate opens is named after the job it was handed. Reasoning sticks. In Simple mode, picking a Reasoning level in a bot's panel now also makes it that bot's default, the same way Model does. New conversations start at that level. Chief of Staff mail checks also read your connected Outlook. A failed turn says why it ended in its summary. Codex "Compact now" compacts the conversation in place. Your project's skills win. With "Use my Claude Code skills" on, a project skill takes priority over your own skill of the same name. Lighter isolated Claude turn

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.176
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.176 Updates and announcements A blue update button. In Simple mode, a round blue button appears right after Connect apps while an update downloads or is ready. Click it to restart into the new version. It disappears once you're updated. What each update brought. Announcements now lists every release, newest first. Each card says what that update brought, and "See all changes" shows the full list. Bots and work Check before done (per bot, off by default). Turn it on, and a bot's answer is checked by another bot before it reaches you. A writer and a checker. New ready-made bots in Templates → Writing: Nib edits only what you asked, and Vera checks the result against your document. What changed. When a bot edits a document you gave it, you can see exactly what changed, sentence by sentence. The bot can check its own changes instead of describing them from memory. Saved too

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.175
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.175 A calmer look A new conversation starts when you send. New conversation, a bot's + and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+N open a blank chat, and nothing is saved until you send the first message. Leave it without sending and nothing is left behind. Advanced mode's composer is calmer. The message field gets its own line, with one quiet row beneath it: + , the model, and the voice or send button. Attach, Teach a task, Work until done, approvals, where the bot works and call mode all sit in the + menu. Quieter sidebar rows in Simple mode. A row's AI mark shows when you hover over it, and the sidebar stays open beside a bot's panel on windows 1040 px and wider. Chat finish. The composer gets a soft lift, bot bubbles get a light sheen and small tails, and buttons and bot rows respond when pressed. Mascots hold still at rest, with eased blinks and hover gaze. Type, sizing and icons use one

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.173
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.173 Long chats Long threads keep going: Claude and Codex bots now compact their own sessions, and the summary is written before the limit is reached instead of at it. A text selection survives scrolling away in a long chat, and scrolling through history is smoother. Rooms Saved messages hold still while members of a room are replying. Speed The app starts a little sooner: saved keys and the system proxy are read while the splash is showing, and the server starts listening earlier. Hide and Unhide for a provider answer at once. MausBot Cloud Clearer Cloud sign-in: when a saved sign-in on this computer can't be used, the app says so and offers to clear it and sign in again, instead of showing "couldn't reach". A browser sign-in that is still open can be cancelled from the same sheet to use the email code. When this computer can't connect to your Cloud's address, the app n

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.171
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.171 Bots Bots check back later: a bot can set itself a reminder to look at something again, instead of waiting in the chat. Hand-offs show who is working on what, so you can see the status of work passed between bots. A bot working on a cloud computer keeps its engine between turns, so its next reply starts sooner. Spending Usage charts in Spending, shown in Simple mode too. Sharing Share and import polish: the product name, plain taglines, folder pictures, and Share in Advanced mode. Speed Faster replies: Codex turns stay warm, Claude starts ahead of your message, and threads and new bots load lighter. Smoother chat while a reply streams: saved rows hold still, rooms draw one bubble per update, and long lists and tables no longer slow down as they grow. Switching bots shows the newest messages first. Long chats stay light however far you scroll back. Fixes The CLI logi

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.170
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.170 Getting started Claude, ChatGPT and OpenCode are all first choices when you set up MausBot, on desktop and in the Cloud welcome. OpenCode installs in one click and has free models that need no account. The Teams popup links to Team plans, and everyone sees it once more. OpenCode OpenCode 2.3.2. A message sent while an OpenCode bot is working now joins its running turn, instead of waiting for it to finish. Stop ends everything. Stopping an OpenCode bot also ends the work it had moved to the background, so nothing keeps running unseen. OpenCode no longer reads your own Claude instructions ( CLAUDE.md ). Devin bots can be steered mid-turn too, when Devin supports it. Inbox Pinned conversations sit on top, with a Finished list of what you've recently read. Unread dots, a mark on the conversation you have open, and a card showing your last message above the unread ones.

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.169
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.169 Teams Team files: one shared folder for the team and its bots. Team templates: a team library, templates from private GitHub repositories, and scripts that travel with their skills. Bitwarden in the Vault: logins and secrets through Bitwarden, alongside 1Password. What's new for everyone, and an Announcements page with a dot when there is something unread. Bots and skills Bots can import a skill from GitHub or skills.sh. Up to 10 connected accounts per app (was 5). Rooms say where a queued teammate is busy and that it starts when that work finishes. A bot reads its own hand-offs from any of its own chats. Pause and Resume every bot in the Advanced-mode bot menu. One set of names for approval levels in Simple and Advanced mode. Chat Right-click menu for media, and large chat videos and audio now stream instead of loading whole. A new chat is suggested under the lates

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.166
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.166 Publish sites and apps Sites a bot publishes to your Netlify account are public by default. Anyone with the link can open them, even when your Netlify team protects new sites. Ask for a private site and the bot keeps it private, and remembers that choice. A live preview in the chat. When a bot publishes one of your sites or pages, its reply shows a small live preview with Open and Open in browser. Fewer tokens, same rules Each request carries less fixed text: a new bot's built-in instructions are about 18% smaller and a Chief's about 15%, with every rule kept. Some tools are now loaded only when needed, and text that rarely changes is cached instead of re-sent. Settings you can find Every "Settings → …" the app and its bots mention is a real place , in every language that has it. Chat and sidebar The chat header and sidebar are easier to read: the open conversation

entries.title: OpenMausBot 0.1.165
entries.note: What's new in 0.1.165 Bots work on your computer, simply New bots on the Mac and Windows app work on This computer by default. The choices now say plainly what they mean: This computer uses your files and apps; a Private desktop can't see your files; Browser is websites only. A bot offers the switch itself. When a task needs your own files and the bot isn't on This computer, it says so in one line and switches with one tap, then carries on. No more hunting for settings that don't exist. Bots on API models (OpenRouter, Groq, local models…) can read and save files on This computer , not only drive the screen. Your approval level decides what is asked. Windows: the computer tools start reliably. They no longer drop out of a turn when they take a few seconds to start. Chat runs the app for you Bots name only real places in Settings , and can look them up. Sign in to Claude, ChatGPT or Antigr
